name: translate-monorepo
description: Auto Transliteration — mobile-first speech translation (local Whisper → MyMemory → on-device speech synthesis)

scripts._comment:dev:server: PORT is pinned here on purpose: dev tooling often exports PORT for the web app (5173), and the API must not inherit it. Render sets PORT normally in production.
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @translate/server && npm run build --workspace @translate/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @translate/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @translate/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @translate/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @translate/shared && npm run test --workspace @translate/server && npm run test --workspace @translate/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit --workspace @translate/shared && npm run test:unit --workspace @translate/server && npm run test:unit --workspace @translate/web
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration --workspace @translate/server && npm run test:integration --workspace @translate/web
scripts.test:ab: npm run test:ab --workspace @translate/server && npm run test:ab --workspace @translate/web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace @translate/server && npm run test:coverage --workspace @translate/web
